title: GR00T 2: Scaling Robot Foundation Models for Generalization, Dexterity, and Adaptation
scope: Whole-body loco-manipulation: Sections 2, 3.5, 4.1, Appendix H/I and J.3 G1 Factory

release_status.value: Official project announces code available in December; no complete GR00T 2 release verified.

evidence_boundaries: Scope is whole-body loco-manipulation, not complete report coverage
G1 task post-training uses whole-body teleoperation and simulation; human-video-only G1 transfer not demonstrated
Popcorn and spill are single-task policies; pick-and-place is a multitask policy with crosshair target guidance
Same controller, action space and task demonstrations across Table 25 baselines; pretraining differs
80.8 percent is task-macro average, not trial-pooled success
OOD Table 26 evaluates unseen scenes and locations, not arbitrary unseen tasks
Co-trained OOD comparison 19 versus 12 of 30 has Fisher exact p approximately 0.12
Video prediction explanation for sim-real transfer is a hypothesis, not isolated G1 causal ablation
Official webpage calls backbone smaller, but report Section 2 and Appendix I use 2B for both; higher video compression is explicit
123.97 ms is model prediction p50, not end-to-end control latency; planner runs approximately 1 Hz
S1 runs on Thor and S0 on Orin NX; optional reasoning model is not claimed onboard
Table 34 G1 Factory is simulated and uses arm-hand-waist plus base/nav interface, not real Turbo SONIC evaluation
Code announcement is December; old WBC repository is not complete GR00T 2 release
